# XSS corpus for Clean: filter-evasion payloads in the style of the OWASP cheat sheet, mutation XSS
# known from DOMPurify and PortSwigger research, character references without ";", control
# characters inside addresses, and hosts hidden behind backslashes; and, for the grammar of 20/10/2026,
# alignment classes injected or spelt with references, text-align with expression() and url(), markup
# and end tags breaking out of a pre, code inside a and a inside code, rules with attributes: nothing
# of a class, a style or an align attribute reaches the output, the writer spells one of two classes.
#
# A case is "== name", the source lines, then "-- want" and the HTML Clean must give ("" when the
# want is empty). Characters a text file cannot hold plainly are written {NUL} {SOH} {TAB} {LF} {CR}
# {FF} {VT} {ESC} {DEL} {NBSP} {ZWSP} {BOM} or {U+XXXX}, and a byte that is not UTF-8 {BYTE:XX}.

== script tag with a source
<SCRIPT SRC=http://xss.rocks/xss.js></SCRIPT>after
-- want
<p>after</p>

== polyglot
javascript:/*--></title></style></textarea></script></xmp><svg/onload='+/"/+/onmouseover=1/+/[*/[]/+alert(1)//'>
-- want
<p>javascript:/*--&gt;</p>

== image with a script source
<IMG SRC="javascript:alert('XSS');">
-- want

== image without quotes
<IMG SRC=javascript:alert('XSS')>image
-- want
<p>image</p>

== image with mixed case
<IMG SRC=JaVaScRiPt:alert('XSS')>
-- want

== grave accents
<IMG SRC=`javascript:alert("RSnake says, 'XSS'")`>
-- want

== malformed a with an event
<a onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)">xxs link</a>
-- want
<p>xxs link</p>

== malformed img
<IMG """><SCRIPT>alert("XSS")</SCRIPT>"\>
-- want
<p>"\&gt;</p>

== fromCharCode
<IMG SRC=javascript:alert(String.fromCharCode(88,83,83))>
-- want

== onerror with references without semicolons
<img src=x onerror="&#0000106&#0000097&#0000118&#0000097&#0000115&#0000099&#0000114&#0000105&#0000112&#0000116&#0000058&#0000097&#0000108&#0000101&#0000114&#0000116&#0000040&#0000039&#0000088&#0000083&#0000083&#0000039&#0000041">
-- want

== decimal references in href
<a href="&#106;&#97;&#118;&#97;&#115;&#99;&#114;&#105;&#112;&#116;&#58;&#97;&#108;&#101;&#114;&#116;&#40;&#39;&#88;&#83;&#83;&#39;&#41;">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== long decimal references without semicolons
<a href="&#0000106&#0000097&#0000118&#0000097&#0000115&#0000099&#0000114&#0000105&#0000112&#0000116&#0000058alert(1)">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== hex references without semicolons
<a href="&#x6A&#x61&#x76&#x61&#x73&#x63&#x72&#x69&#x70&#x74&#x3A&#x61&#x6C&#x65&#x72&#x74&#x28&#x27&#x58&#x53&#x53&#x27&#x29">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== embedded tab
<a href="jav{TAB}ascript:alert('XSS');">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

<a href="jav&#x09;ascript:alert('XSS');">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

-- want
<p>x</p>

== encoded carriage return
<a href="jav&#x0D;ascript:alert('XSS');">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== null inside the scheme
<a href="java{NUL}script:alert('XSS');">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== spaces and a control character in front
<a href=" &#14;  javascript:alert('XSS');">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== named references without semicolons
<a href="javascript&colon;alert(1)">a</a><a href="java&Tab;script:alert(1)">b</a><a href="java&NewLine;script:alert(1)">c</a>
-- want
<p>abc</p>

== colon reference with a semicolon
<a href="JaVaScRiPt&colon;alert(1)">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== decimal colon without a semicolon
<a href="javascript&#58alert(1)">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== encoded space and control in front
<a href="&#x20;javascript:alert(1)">a</a><a href="&#x01;javascript:alert(1)">b</a>
-- want
<p>ab</p>

== leading zeros in a hex reference
<a href="ja&#x0000A;vascript:alert(1)">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== a single digit reference Go leaves alone
<a href="/a&#9x">x</a>
-- want
<p><a href="/a&amp;#9x">x</a></p>

== data and vbscript
<a href="data:text/html;base64,PHNjcmlwdD5hbGVydCgxKTwvc2NyaXB0Pg==">a</a> <a href="vbscript:msgbox(1)">b</a> <a href="DATA:text/html,x">c</a>
-- want
<p>a b c</p>

== a script address behind U+2028
<a href="java{U+2028}script:alert(1)">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== fullwidth letters
<a href="{U+FF4A}{U+FF41}{U+FF56}{U+FF41}script:alert(1)">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== backslash in front of a host
<a href="/\evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== two backslashes
<a href="\\evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== backslash then slash
<a href="\/evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== tab between the slashes
<a href="/{TAB}/evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== carriage return between the slashes
<a href="/{CR}/evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== line feed between the slashes
<a href="/{LF}/evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== encoded tab between the slashes
<a href="/&#9;/evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== encoded backslashes
<a href="&#92;&#92;evil.example">a</a><a href="/&bsol;evil.example">b</a>
-- want
<p>ab</p>

== null between the slashes
<a href="/{NUL}/evil.example">x</a>
-- want
<p>x</p>

== protocol relative
<A HREF="//www.google.com/">XSS</A>
-- want
<p>XSS</p>

== a web address written with backslashes
<a href="https:\\evil.example\path">x</a>
-- want
<p><a href="https://evil.example/path">x</a></p>

== a user name hiding the host
<a href="https://evil.example\@kitwork.io/">a</a> <a href="https://kitwork.io\@evil.example/">b</a>
-- want
<p><a href="https://evil.example/@kitwork.io/">a</a> <a href="https://kitwork.io/@evil.example/">b</a></p>

== addresses a link may not hold
<a href="#top">a</a> <a href="?q=1">b</a> <a href="page.html">c</a> <a href="evil.example">d</a> <a href="../up">e</a> <a href="">f</a> <a href>g</a>
-- want
<p>a b c d e f g</p>

== addresses a link may hold
<a href="mailto:hi@kitwork.io">a</a> <a href="tel:+84901234567">b</a> <a href="HTTPS://Kitwork.io">c</a> <a href="/">d</a> <a href="http://66.102.7.147/">e</a> <a href="http://%77%77%77%2E%67%6F%6F%67%6C%65%2E%63%6F%6D">f</a>
-- want
<p><a href="mailto:hi@kitwork.io">a</a> <a href="tel:+84901234567">b</a> <a href="HTTPS://Kitwork.io">c</a> <a href="/">d</a> <a href="http://66.102.7.147/">e</a> <a href="http://%77%77%77%2E%67%6F%6F%67%6C%65%2E%63%6F%6D">f</a></p>

== a dotted host written with tabs and newlines
<A HREF="h{LF}tt{TAB}p://6{TAB}6.000146.0x7.147/">XSS</A>
-- want
<p><a href="http://66.000146.0x7.147/">XSS</a></p>

== an address with markup inside
<a href="https://a.example/?q=<script>&quot;x&quot;">x</a>
-- want
<p><a href="https://a.example/?q=&lt;script&gt;&quot;x&quot;">x</a></p>

== an address breaking out of its quotes
<a href="https://a.example/&quot; onmouseover=&quot;alert(1)">x</a>
-- want
<p><a href="https://a.example/&quot; onmouseover=&quot;alert(1)">x</a></p>

== references in a path
<a href="/a&amp;b&lt;c&gt;d&nbsp;e">x</a>
-- want
<p><a href="/a&amp;b&lt;c&gt;d&nbsp;e">x</a></p>

== legacy references without a semicolon, the way a browser reads them in an attribute
<a href="/search?x=1&copy=2">a</a> <a href="/search?lang=vi&region=vn">b</a> <a href="/a&amp=1&notit;&copy 2&lt">c</a>
-- want
<p><a href="/search?x=1&amp;copy=2">a</a> <a href="/search?lang=vi&amp;region=vn">b</a> <a href="/a&amp;amp=1&amp;notit;© 2&lt;">c</a></p>

== the first href wins
<a href="javascript:alert(1)" href="/ok">a</a> <a href="/ok" href="javascript:alert(1)">b</a>
-- want
<p>a <a href="/ok">b</a></p>

== events and styles
<a href=/ok onclick=alert(1) style="color:red" target=_blank rel=opener>x</a><p id=x class=y style="background:url(javascript:alert(1))" onclick=alert(1) title=t>p</p>
-- want
<p><a href="/ok">x</a></p>
<p>p</p>

== slash before the attribute
<a/href="javascript:alert(1)">a</a> <a/href="/ok">b</a>
-- want
<p>a <a href="/ok">b</a></p>

== spaces around the equals sign
<a href = "javascript:alert(1)">a</a> <a href = "/ok">b</a>
-- want
<p>a <a href="/ok">b</a></p>

<a href=javascript:alert(1)>x</a>
-- want

== a title holding markup

-- want
<p><a href="/x">y</a></p>

== the meta charset trick
<meta charset="x-imap4-modified-utf7">&ADz&AGn&AG0&AEf&ACA&AHM&AHI&AGO&AD0&AGn&ACA&AG8Abg&AGUAcgByAG8AcgA9AGEAbABlAHIAdAAoADEAKQ&ACAAPABi
-- want
<p>&amp;ADz&amp;AGn&amp;AG0&amp;AEf&amp;ACA&amp;AHM&amp;AHI&amp;AGO&amp;AD0&amp;AGn&amp;ACA&amp;AG8Abg&amp;AGUAcgByAG8AcgA9AGEAbABlAHIAdAAoADEAKQ&amp;ACAAPABi</p>

== a class beside the alignment
<p class="align-center x">a</p><p class="x align-right y">b</p><h3 class="lead align-center">c</h3>
-- want
<p class="align-center">a</p>
<p class="align-right">b</p>
<h3 class="align-center">c</h3>

== a class breaking out of its quotes
<p class="align-center&quot; onmouseover=&quot;alert(1)">a</p><p class='align-center" onclick="alert(1)'>b</p><p class="align-center"onclick="alert(1)">c</p>
-- want
<p>a</p>
<p>b</p>
<p class="align-center">c</p>

== a class written with references
<p class="align&#45;center">a</p><p class="align&#x2D;right&#32;x">b</p><p class="align&hyphen;center">c</p><p class="align&minus;right">d</p>
-- want
<p class="align-center">a</p>
<p class="align-right">b</p>
<p>c</p>
<p>d</p>

== classes not of the grammar, in another case, on an element that takes none
<p class="ALIGN-CENTER">a</p><p class="align-left">b</p><p class="align-justify">c</p><span class="align-center">d</span> <a href="/x" class="align-right">e</a><ul><li class="align-center">f</li></ul>
-- want
<p>a</p>
<p>b</p>
<p>c</p>
<p>d <a href="/x">e</a></p>
<ul>
<li>f</li>
</ul>

== the first class attribute wins
<p class="x" class="align-center">a</p><p class="align-right" class="align-center">b</p>
-- want
<p>a</p>
<p class="align-right">b</p>

== an alignment beside events
<p class=align-center onmouseover=alert(1) style="color:red">a</p><div align=right onclick="alert(1)">b</div>
-- want
<p class="align-center">a</p>
<p class="align-right">b</p>

== text-align with expression and url
<p style="text-align:expression(alert(1))">a</p><p style="text-align:url(javascript:alert(1))">b</p><p style="text-align:center;behavior:url(x.htc)">c</p><p style="background:url(javascript:alert(1));text-align:right">d</p><p style="width:expression(alert(1));text-align:center !important">e</p>
-- want
<p>a</p>
<p>b</p>
<p class="align-center">c</p>
<p class="align-right">d</p>
<p class="align-center">e</p>

== text-align written with references, markup, a comment or an escape

-- want
<p class="align-center">a</p>
<p>b</p>
<p>c</p>
<p>d</p>

== the align attribute with other values
<p align="javascript:alert(1)">a</p><p align=CENTER>b</p><h2 align=middle>c</h2><p align=" right">d</p><div align=center><p align=left>e</p><p>f</p></div>
-- want
<p>a</p>
<p class="align-center">b</p>
<h2 class="align-center">c</h2>
<p>d</p>
<p>e</p>
<p class="align-center">f</p>

== a heading and a quote paragraph aligned, a list item not
<h4 class="align-right" id="x" onclick="alert(1)">a</h4><h1 align=center>b</h1><blockquote class="align-center"><p>c</p><p class="align-right">d</p></blockquote><ul style="text-align:center"><li>e</li></ul>
-- want
<h4 class="align-right">a</h4>
<h2 class="align-center">b</h2>
<blockquote>
<p class="align-center">c</p>
<p class="align-right">d</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>e</li>
</ul>

== a pre holding escaped markup
<pre>&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt;</pre>
-- want
<pre><code>&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;&lt;img src=x onerror=alert(1)&gt;</code></pre>

== a pre holding markup
<pre><b>bold</b> <a href="/x">link</a> <a href="javascript:alert(1)">bad</a><img src=x onerror=alert(1)><script>alert(1)</script><svg onload=alert(1)><p>out</p></svg></pre>
-- want
<pre><code>bold link bad
out</code></pre>

== the end of a pre breaking out
<pre><code></pre><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>after</code>
-- want
<p>after</p>

== a pre inside a pre, and a textarea in one
<pre>a<pre>b</pre>c<textarea></pre><script>alert(1)</script></textarea>d</pre>e
-- want
<pre><code>a
b
cd</code></pre>
<p>e</p>

== a comment and CDATA in a pre
<pre>a<!--</pre><script>alert(1)</script>-->b<![CDATA[</pre><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>]]>c</pre>
-- want
<pre><code>ab]]&gt;c</code></pre>

== a carriage return written as a reference in a pre
<pre>a&#13;b&#13;&#10;c&#x0D;<b>&#10;d</b>&#13e</pre>
-- want
<pre><code>a
b
c
d
e</code></pre>

== a pre whose end tag is written oddly
<pre>a</pre ><script>alert(1)</script><pre>b</PRE foo="</pre>"><img src=x onerror=alert(1)>c
-- want
<pre><code>a</code></pre>
<pre><code>b</code></pre>
<p>c</p>

== code inside a and a inside code
<a href="/x"><code>x</code></a> <code><a href="/y">y</a></code> <code><a href="javascript:alert(1)">z</a></code>
-- want
<p><a href="/x"><code>x</code></a> <a href="/y"><code>y</code></a> <code>z</code></p>

== a rule with attributes
<p>a</p><hr class="align-center" style="border:1px solid url(javascript:alert(1))" onclick="alert(1)" id="x" noshade size=9><p>b</p>
-- want
<p>a</p>
<hr>
<p>b</p>

== rules first, doubled and last
<hr/onmouseover=alert(1)><hr><p>a</p><hr><hr><p></p><hr><p>b</p><hr><hr>
-- want
<p>a</p>
<hr>
<p>b</p>
<hr>

== marks with attributes
<u onclick=alert(1) style="text-decoration:none">a</u> <ins cite="javascript:alert(1)">b</ins> <s title="x">c</s> <del datetime=x>d</del> <strike>e</strike> <kbd onmouseover=x>f</kbd> <samp>g</samp> <tt>h</tt>
-- want
<p><u>a</u> <u>b</u> <s>c</s> <s>d</s> <s>e</s> <code>f</code> <code>g</code> <code>h</code></p>

== mutation XSS: a code block in svg, a style in a code block
<svg><pre><code>x</code></pre><style><img src=x onerror=alert(1)></style></svg><pre><style></pre><img src=x onerror=alert(1)></style>y</pre>
-- want
<pre><code>x</code></pre>
<pre><code>y</code></pre>
